sourceRef.section: MAGE SPELLS, General Mage Spells, Elementalist Spells, Additional Fire Spell — Flame Lance, Necromancer Spells, Illusionist Spells

description: Mage spells manipulate arcane energy, elemental forces, life and death, and perception.

spells.name: Seeking Darts
spells.effect: Small projectiles of arcane energy pursue exposed targets. Pinpoint allows the spell to ignore the normal penalty for attacking enemies Engaged with another Unit.

spells.name: Concussive Pulse
spells.effect: When the Attack deals Damage, push the target up to 1" directly away from the caster. This is forced movement and does not count as Disengaging.

spells.name: Arcane Lance
spells.effect: A concentrated magical projectile designed to inflict significant Damage. Its Heavy restriction prevents normal use after moving.

elementalistSpells.description: Elementalist spells emphasize elemental destruction, environmental hazards, and forced movement.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.effect: A bolt of electricity arcs through nearby targets. On a Surge, resolve Blast 1" around the original target.

spells.name: Glacial Lance
spells.effect: A large magical projectile capable of piercing armor and freezing enemies. On a Surge, the target suffers Slow 2 until the end of its next Movement activation.

additionalFireSpell.name: Flame Lance
additionalFireSpell.effect: A concentrated Fire Attack with strong single-target Damage. It follows the normal Heavy restriction. Because it has only one Attack die, Flame Lance cannot naturally Surge without an explicit Attack-dice increase. It counts as Fire Damage only when the target takes unsaved Damage.
notes: This new option is provisionally priced and is available to Elementalists through normal additional-spell acquisition.

necromancerSpells.description: Necromancer spells manipulate deathly energies, weaken living defenses, and overwhelm enemies with supernatural projectiles.

spells.name: Withering Grasp
spells.effect: If this Attack deals Damage, worsen the target's Armor by 1 step until the end of the Round. The penalty applies after this Attack resolves.

spells.name: Bone Volley
spells.effect: The caster launches a cloud of magically animated bone fragments. On a Surge, the Attack gains Critical 1, converting up to one failed Hit die into a Critical Hit after rerolls.

illusionistSpells.description: Illusionist spells employ psychic force, false sensory information, and supernatural misdirection.

spells.name: Phantasmal Blade
spells.effect: The caster manifests an illusory weapon capable of inflicting real injury. On a Surge, gain Critical 1 for this Attack.

spells.name: Nightmare Gaze
spells.effect: If this Attack deals Damage, the target cannot use Reaction abilities until the end of the Round. Passive abilities remain unaffected.

designNotes: v4 balance pass (post-playtesting): Damage-1 spells gained +1 Attack; Damage-2/Heavy spells (Arcane Lance, Glacial Lance, Flame Lance) kept their listed Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] 1, matching the equivalent policy applied to PC equipment and Generic Units.
v5 balance pass (second damage-output pass): Damage-1 spells gained a further +1 Attack; Damage-2/Heavy spells (Arcane Lance, Glacial Lance, Flame Lance) raised their Anti-[Type] to 2.
